reason: Merges the message trigger config into one metadata-driven component that reuses HogFlowPropertyFilters, but keeps `node: any` and adds another near-duplicate trigger registration.
Self-contained, well-tested one-off cleanup command. It repeats the draft-extraction logic in the scan and locked paths and leaves the module structure unchanged.
